metadata.title: The 'Absolutely Fireproof' Theatre That Became a Trap
metadata.description:
Iroquois Theatre burned during a packed matinee. The cause: a jammed fire curtain, blocked or confusing exits and doors that opened inward.

Failure chain: Stage light sparks → Curtain catches fire → Safety curtain jams → Exits locked or hidden → Crowd crush at doors

Related episode: What Engineers Changed After Beirut — https://youtu.be/MdDPiLh09K8
